performance.verdict: No paid channels live; 5 overdue milestones are the real risk.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed their 2026-07-31 deadline — 24+ days overdue with no completion recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting both missed their 2026-08-01 deadline — 23 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms neither is live.
GBP actions fell 17% week-over-week (96 actions over 28 days); last 3 days show 0, 0, 0 GBP actions vs prior 3-day avg of 2.0 — declining trend, not noise.
Instagram reach dropped 41% week-over-week; last 3 days avg 717 vs prior 3-day avg of 762 — modest but consistent decline with no paid amplification to buffer it.
GHL shows 366 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — pipeline is not functional; leads arriving organically have nowhere to go in the system.

suggestions.text: Escalate Pre-Launch Stack Test and LSA Verification to Nacer immediately — both are 24+ days overdue and blocking all paid launch.
